cow.definition: A large farm animal kept for milk, meat, and sometimes leather.

pig.definition: A farm animal with a short snout, kept for meat.

chicken.definition: A bird kept on farms for eggs and meat.

horse.definition: A large strong animal used for riding or farm work.

sheep.definition: A farm animal with thick wool covering its body.

goat.definition: A farm animal with horns that can provide milk or meat.

duck.definition: A water bird often kept for eggs, meat, or feathers.

donkey.definition: A strong animal related to a horse, known for carrying loads.

turkey.definition: A large farm bird with a fan-shaped tail, often eaten at holidays.

rooster.definition: An adult male chicken with a bright comb and long tail feathers.

hen.definition: An adult female chicken that lays eggs.

lamb.definition: A young sheep with soft wool and a short tail.

wheat.definition: A cereal plant whose grains are ground into flour.

corn.definition: A tall cereal plant with yellow grains used for food or animal feed.

carrot.definition: A long orange root vegetable that grows underground.

potato.definition: A round underground vegetable often boiled, baked, or fried.

tomato.definition: A soft red fruit used in salads, sauces, and cooking.

lettuce.definition: A leafy green vegetable often used in salads.

onion.definition: A strong-smelling vegetable with layers used in cooking.

pumpkin.definition: A large round orange vegetable with thick skin and many seeds.

bean.definition: A small edible seed that grows inside a pod.

pea.definition: A small round green seed that grows in a pod.

cabbage.definition: A leafy vegetable with a tight round head.

beetroot.definition: A round root vegetable with dark red or purple skin.

apple-tree.definition: A tree grown for its round fruit, which may be red, green, or yellow.

pear-tree.definition: A tree grown for its sweet, juicy pears.

cherry-tree.definition: A tree that produces small round cherries.

strawberry.definition: A small red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface.

blueberry.definition: A small round blue or purple fruit that grows on a bush.

raspberry.definition: A soft red berry that grows on a bush.

grape-vine.definition: A climbing plant that produces bunches of grapes.

peach-tree.definition: A tree that produces soft, juicy fruit with fuzzy skin.

plum-tree.definition: A tree that produces smooth-skinned fruit with a stone inside.

barn.definition: A large farm building used for animals, hay, or equipment.

farmhouse.definition: A house where a farmer and family live.

silo.definition: A tall container used to store grain or other dry materials.

chicken-coop.definition: A building where chickens are kept.

stable.definition: A building where horses are kept and cared for.

greenhouse.definition: A building with glass walls or a roof for growing plants.

storage-shed.definition: A small building used for storing farm tools and supplies.

windmill.definition: A machine with large blades that uses wind to produce power.

dairy.definition: A place where milk is processed into dairy products.

well.definition: A deep hole in the ground used for collecting water.

tractor.definition: A large vehicle used for pulling equipment and doing farm work.

plow.definition: A tool with a heavy blade used for turning soil.

trailer.definition: A vehicle without an engine that is pulled by another vehicle.

hay-bale.definition: A bundle of dried grass used as animal food or bedding.

pitchfork.definition: A long-handled tool with pointed prongs for lifting hay.

bucket.definition: A round open container used for carrying liquids or materials.

wheelbarrow.definition: A tool with a large open tray and one or two wheels.

feed-trough.definition: A container from which farm animals eat or drink.

water-tank.definition: A large container used for storing water.

scarecrow.definition: A model of a person placed in a field to frighten birds away.

milk.definition: A white dairy drink that is also used in cereal and cooking.

egg.definition: An oval food with a shell, white, and yellow center.

wool.definition: Soft hair from sheep, used to make warm cloth.

honey.definition: A thick sweet golden liquid made by bees.

cheese.definition: A solid dairy product available in slices, blocks, or grated pieces.

butter.definition: A soft yellow dairy product spread on toast or used in cooking.

cream.definition: The thick part of milk used to make butter and other foods.

flour.definition: A fine pale powder made from grain and used to make dough.

jam.definition: A sweet spread made by cooking fruit with sugar.

apple-cider.definition: A sweet drink made by pressing apples.

rabbit.definition: A small furry animal often kept on farms for meat or pets.

goose.definition: A large water bird with a long neck and white feathers.

hen-house.definition: A building where hens are kept and lay eggs.

shed.definition: A small farm building used for storage or animals.

fence.definition: A barrier made of posts or wire around land.

shovel.definition: A hand tool with a broad blade for digging soil.

hoe.definition: A hand tool with a short handle and a blade for breaking soil.

rake.definition: A garden tool with a row of teeth for gathering leaves or loosening soil.

watering-can.definition: A container with a handle and narrow spout for watering plants.

sunflower.definition: A tall plant with a large yellow flower and edible seeds.

hay.definition: Dried grass used as food for farm animals.

straw.definition: Dry stalks left after grain plants are cut, used for bedding.

farmer.definition: A person who owns or works on a farm.

dog.definition: A domesticated animal often kept on a farm for guarding or companionship.

cat.definition: A small domesticated animal that may live on a farm.

pond.definition: A small area of still water, larger than a puddle.

mud.definition: Wet soft earth that sticks to shoes and animals.

sunrise.definition: The time when the sun first appears in the sky.

sunset.definition: The time when the sun goes down in the evening.

rain.definition: Water that falls from clouds in drops.

harvest.definition: The gathering of crops when they are ready.

saddle.definition: A seat fixed on a horse for a rider.
